people.name: Lo-debar
people.line: A town in Gilead; home of Mephibosheth

translations.web: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’
translations.bsb: you who rejoice in Lo-debar and say, ‘Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?’
translations.kjv: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
translations.asv: ye that rejoice in a thing of nought, that say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
